sources.snippet: This model, Qwen3-8b-urban-qwen-20260920-full-CPT-final-step-1500, is a standalone, merged BF16 version of a Qwen3-8b base model, fine-tuned by BrandonHowe. It was developed over 1500 steps, reaching epoch 3.97, and features a substantial 32768 token context length.

sources.snippet: In this work, we present Qwen3, the latest version of the Qwen model family. Qwen3 comprises a series of large language models (LLMs) designed to advance performance, efficiency, and multilingual capabilities.
